mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.2%) indicates accommodative monetary policy, which reduces discount rates for equity valuation and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.2%, or the Rank IC for FEDFUNDS is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate above 5.5% signals labor market deterioration, which typically precedes economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in residential construction (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In an expansionary business cycle, rising industrial production (INDPRO above 100) signals strengthening supply conditions and corporate profitability, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In expansionary business cycles, INDPRO above 100 fails to predict positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for INDPRO in expansion is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL above 275) signals potential monetary tightening, which increases discount rates and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 275.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicates a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS is rising (e.g., above 3-month moving average).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, low residential construction (HOUST below 1650) signals an impending economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansions, HOUST below 1650 fails to predict negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of very low interest rates (FEDFUNDS below 0.2%) and high inflation (CPIAUCSL above 275) signals a central bank's inability to control inflation, leading to market uncertainty and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of FEDFUNDS < 0.2 and CPIAUCSL > 275 fails to predict negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.
